payload.intent:
Wire vaultsparkstudios.com login + create-account through Obelisk Gate (the studio IdP at https://obeliskgate.com), and add the Secured-by-Obelisk verified seal card. Identity = Obelisk; your membership/vault plan stays 100% in your own system, joined only by the Obelisk user id (OIDC sub). You hold ZERO Obelisk secrets and build NO password/reset logic. Steps: (1) Add the seal card to your login + create-account pages: include and a
(use data-mode=signup on the create-account page). (2) Implement OIDC authorization-code + PKCE: on /login generate state+nonce+PKCE code_verifier (store in HttpOnly cookie), redirect to https://obeliskgate.com/auth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=vaultsparkstudios-website&redirect_uri=https://vaultsparkstudios.com/auth/callback&scope=openid%20email%20profile&code_challenge=S256(verifier)&code_challenge_method=S256&state=..&nonce=.. (S256 is REQUIRED, Obelisk rejects plain). (3) On /auth/callback verify state, POST server-to-server to https://obeliskgate.com/auth/token (grant_type=authorization_code, code, code_verifier, redirect_uri, client_id) to get id_token+access_token+refresh_token; verify id_token against https://obeliskgate.com/.well-known/jwks.json; read sub, email, email_verified, name. The helper @vaultspark/obelisk-auth does this. (4) Set YOUR OWN app session cookie. (5) Key your member rows by the Obelisk sub: existing sub -> load their membership/vault plan; new sub -> create a member row + your normal onboarding. Your membership logic is unchanged. (6) Do NOT build reset/verification email; Obelisk sends all account email from no-reply@vaultsparkstudios.com (already DKIM-authenticated in Brevo) with a Secured-by-Obelisk footer. Full reference doc lives in the obelisk repo at docs/IDENTITY_ARCHITECTURE.md + docs/handoffs/VAULTSPARKSTUDIOS_OBELISK_INTEGRATION.md.
